SELECT b.i_item_id, b.ca_country, b.ca_state, b.ca_county,
       SUM(b.sum_cs_quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(b.count_cs_quantity), 0) AS agg1,
       SUM(b.sum_cs_list_price) / NULLIF(SUM(b.count_cs_list_price), 0) AS agg2,
       SUM(b.sum_cs_coupon_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(b.count_cs_coupon_amt), 0) AS agg3,
       SUM(b.sum_cs_sales_price) / NULLIF(SUM(b.count_cs_sales_price), 0) AS agg4,
       SUM(b.sum_cs_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(b.count_cs_net_profit), 0) AS agg5,
       SUM(b.sum_c_birth_year) / NULLIF(SUM(b.count_c_birth_year), 0) AS agg6,
       SUM(b.sum_cd_dep_count) / NULLIF(SUM(b.count_cd_dep_count), 0) AS agg7
FROM (
    SELECT i.i_item_id,
           cust_addr.ca_country,
           cust_addr.ca_state,
           cust_addr.ca_county,
           SUM(CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS decimal(12,2))) AS sum_cs_quantity,
           COUNT(CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS decimal(12,2))) AS count_cs_quantity,
           SUM(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS sum_cs_list_price,
           COUNT(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS count_cs_list_price,
           SUM(CAST(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS decimal(12,2))) AS sum_cs_coupon_amt,
           COUNT(CAST(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS decimal(12,2))) AS count_cs_coupon_amt,
           SUM(CAST(cs.cs_sales_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS sum_cs_sales_price,
           COUNT(CAST(cs.cs_sales_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS count_cs_sales_price,
           SUM(CAST(cs.cs_net_profit AS decimal(12,2))) AS sum_cs_net_profit,
           COUNT(CAST(cs.cs_net_profit AS decimal(12,2))) AS count_cs_net_profit,
           SUM(CAST(cust_addr.c_birth_year AS decimal(12,2))) AS sum_c_birth_year,
           COUNT(CAST(cust_addr.c_birth_year AS decimal(12,2))) AS count_c_birth_year,
           SUM(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS decimal(12,2))) AS sum_cd_dep_count,
           COUNT(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS decimal(12,2))) AS count_cd_dep_count
    FROM catalog_sales AS cs
    JOIN (
        SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
    ) AS cd1 ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year,
               ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county
        FROM customer AS c
        JOIN customer_address AS ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
          AND c.c_current_cdemo_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ca.ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')
    ) AS cust_addr ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cust_addr.c_customer_sk
    JOIN item AS i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk IN (
        SELECT d_date_sk
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_year = 2001
    )
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, cust_addr.ca_country, cust_addr.ca_state, cust_addr.ca_county
) AS b
GROUP BY ROLLUP (b.i_item_id, b.ca_country, b.ca_state, b.ca_county)
ORDER BY b.ca_country, b.ca_state, b.ca_county, b.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
